title: Length is monotone in the coefficient ring and agrees for a surjective ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a ring map from R to S and an S-module M the lemma states that the R-length dominates the S-length, with equality when the ring map is surjective (statement lines 12661-12666). The proof does not estimate lengths of individual quotients: it says that a filtration by S-submodules is in particular a filtration by R-submodules, so the R-length, being a supremum over more filtrations, is at least the S-length; in the surjective case the two classes of submodules coincide, giving equality (proof lines 12668-12674). The observation that the two length functions quantify over nested classes of filtrations is the content. H2.
